ammonia.reason: 970-2000 mg/kg ammonia from lactate consumption and amino-acid deamination by Penicillium camemberti raising pH to ~7

animal_barnyard.reason: p-cresol and indole only tr from tyrosine/tryptophan catabolism, no washed-rind Brevibacterium dominance

bitter.reason: hydrophobic bitter peptides from rennet plus Penicillium aspartyl/metalloprotease proteolysis

blue_moldy.reason: methyl ketones 2-heptanone ~5.58 ppm and 2-nonanone from beta-oxidation by P. camemberti but no Penicillium roqueforti

browning.reason: moderate free amino acids and residual galactose for Maillard but 51.8% moisture limits browning

buttery.reason: diacetyl 74-110 ug/kg from citrate fermentation by Lactococcus lactis biovar diacetylactis and Leuconostoc

cheesy_sweaty.reason: butanoic 35-206 ppm plus hexanoic 23-143 ppm plus octanoic from Penicillium lipase lipolysis

creaminess.reason: 24.26% fat plus 51.8% moisture plus surface deacidification and proteolysis giving spoonable paste

crumbliness.reason: high-moisture mixed rennet-lactic gel with extensive proteolysis is cohesive not crumbly

firmness.reason: 51.8% moisture and mold proteolysis soften paste from firm curd to soft bloomy

floral_honey.reason: 2-phenylethanol ~1 mg/kg from phenylalanine Ehrlich pathway, phenylacetaldehyde NQ

fruity.reason: ethyl butanoate ~6.8 ng/g and ethyl hexanoate from esterification of acids with yeast/Geotrichum ethanol

goaty.reason: 4-methyloctanoic and 4-ethyloctanoic acids not detected in cow-milk Camembert

malty_nutty.reason: 3-methylbutanal 94-142 ug/kg and 3-methylbutanoic 8-214 ppm from leucine Strecker/Ehrlich catabolism

melt.reason: deacidified calcium-depleted para-casein with high moisture flows readily on heating

mushroom_earthy.reason: 1-octen-3-ol 75-130 ug/kg plus 1-octen-3-one 2.2 ug/kg from linoleic acid oxidation by P. camemberti

oil_off.reason: 24.26% fat emulsion partly destabilized by lipolysis and proteolysis releases some free oil on heating

smoky.reason: guaiacol not listed/detected and cheese is unsmoked

sour_vinegar.reason: acetic 13-66 ppm plus lactic acid from mesophilic starters mostly consumed by surface mold deacidification

stretch.reason: no pasta-filata hot-water kneading and proteolyzed casein network cannot align

sulfur_cooked.reason: methanethiol 260-542 ug/kg plus dimethyl sulfide 0.25-0.41 ppm plus methional from methionine catabolism

sweet.reason: lactose depleted by starters, slight sweetness from glycerol and delta-decalactone ~0.9-1.1 ppm

umami.reason: glutamate and savory peptides from extensive surface proteolysis by P. camemberti and Geotrichum
